rules: Freeze raw bytes before normalization and retain source/member SHA256.
RAW, NORMALIZED, and CANONICAL values are separate; normalization cannot prove identity.
FIA CN is preserved as source-native stable identifier and never replaced by AguaYLuz entity IDs.
No FIA public coordinate may establish parcel/facility/monitoring-site identity by proximity.
Population estimates must preserve EVALID/stratum/adjustment semantics; never sum unweighted plot rows as population totals.
Zero-row tables are valid schema manifestations and must not be silently dropped.
Joins must assert expected cardinality and row conservation; M:N multiplication fails closed unless explicitly modeled.
Source snapshot is immutable; future updates become new manifestations and are diffed, never overwritten.
